title: code outside codemother asks build_inspector over the bus
intention: Every code site outside CodeMother that calls build_inspector — the 18 crossing calls in transitions.py and the other code sites — asks her `inspect` verb over the bus instead of importing it.
why: Child of 4c4addb09adb (CairnCommons/tickets/4c4addb09adb-the-code-pipeline-s-inspectors-and-gates-live-inside-codemother.json). Akien 2026-10-27, open-0b203e62c1e0: 'everything that has no purpose other than helping our design and build pipeline for code belongs to code mother.' Outline 9.4.3.3.4, Akien 2026-11-13 on Q#88: once build_inspector moves into CodeMother, code outside her reaches it over the bus — the 18 crossing calls in transitions.py, the other code sites and the proofs that run a sieve over themselves; no published client tool, no fifth exception: 'over the bus. that's what it's for?'
traces_to: outline 9.4.3.3.4 and 10.3.5; RULE 1 (encapsulation, 17.13.1); Law 6 (one owner gates writes)
how: D1: ORDER. Builds after the verb child (written here as 266d39d56d06); a call cannot ask a verb that does not exist. D2: transitions.py's lazy imports at :354, :483, :552, :738, :756, :829, :882, :927, :973-977, :1063, :1073, :1192, :1237 and :2227 become one helper, `_ask_inspector(judge, *args, **kwargs)`, sending `inspect` through bus_client.reach('codemother'). A refusal or an absent bus raises, naming it: a crossing never reads green for want of an answer (Law 7, gates are hard). D3: the other code sites ask the same verb: cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py:107 (resolves_to), skills/{design,intent,sorted}/door.py (reason_has_referent), cairn/devices/cc/scripts/preflight.sh:11, cairn/tools/question/probes/both_ends_agree.py:47, cairn/machines/corrosion/probes/the_comparison_is_read.py:25 (list_runs), and the base probes and cairn/tools/gate/gate.py that name the module. A docstring that names the path is reworded to the new address. D4: PROOF, one tooth per clause.

clauses.claim: no file in the code-site list imports cairn.machines.build_inspector or cairn.devices.codemother.machines.build_inspector (AST read)
a crossing walked over a scratch bus with codemother present reaches the same verdict as before on a red and a green fixture
the same crossing with codemother absent refuses, naming the absent answer, and moves nothing
